description: This file defines search fields configuration for the 'Documents' module in the SuiteCRM application. It specifies query parameters, options, and subqueries for various document attributes used in search operations within the module.
calls: SELECT document_revisions.id FROM document_revisions WHERE document_revisions.deleted=0 AND document_revisions.filename LIKE '{0}'
SELECT favorites.parent_id FROM favorites WHERE favorites.deleted = 0 and favorites.parent_type = 'Documents' and favorites.assigned_user_id = '{1}'
